Verses.Text: Now this is the message that we have heard from him and proclaim to you: God is light, and in him there is no darkness at all.
If we acknowledge our sins, he is faithful and just and will forgive our sins and cleanse us from every wrongdoing.
See what love the Father has bestowed on us that we may be called the children of God. Yet so we are.
Beloved, let us love one another, because love is of God; everyone who loves is begotten by God and knows God.
Whoever is without love does not know God, for God is love.
In this way the love of God was revealed to us: God sent his only Son into the world so that we might have life through him.
In this is love: not that we have loved God, but that he loved us and sent his Son as expiation for our sins.
Beloved, if God so loved us, we also must love one another.
God is love, and whoever remains in love remains in God and God in him.
There is no fear in love, but perfect love drives out fear.
For the love of God is this, that we keep his commandments. And his commandments are not burdensome.
We also know that the Son of God has come and has given us discernment to know the one who is true.
